prompts.prompt: Use case: compositing. Asset type: transparent wearable sprite for the attached stylized 3D robot. The attached robot is a STYLE AND BODY-SHAPE REFERENCE only. Create ONLY an empty short fitted jacket for this robot, with NO robot, NO mannequin, NO body parts, NO cape and NO background. It must look like a real volumetric garment rendered in the exact glossy polished 3D game style of the reference, not a flat icon or vector illustration. View: front three-quarter, facing slightly toward image left, camera slightly above; viewer sees a little more of the right side of the jacket. Shape: broad rounded shoulder sleeves, short thick torso fitting a round barrel chest, curved lower hem ending at the waist, open rounded neck with substantial turned collar, central zipper, two small tailored lower pockets, supple fabric with subtle seams and folds. Sleeves are SHORT, only cover shoulder caps and upper arm; no long sleeves. Color: neutral ivory to silver-gray fabric, neutral charcoal zipper, no colorful details, no emblems, no text. Lighting: broad warm-white key from upper image left, soft purple ambient reflections, deep contact shadows in seams, smooth soft materials, restrained specular highlights. Keep the WHOLE jacket, including sleeves, centered and large on a square canvas with a tight 6% transparent margin. Truly transparent RGBA, no floor or shadow outside the garment. Jacket should have substantial thickness, natural perspective and convincing volume, like clothing wrapping the robot rather than an icon pasted onto it.

extractionAttempts.jacket: Use case: background-extraction. Edit ONLY the background of this existing jacket sprite. Remove the entire baked gray and white checkerboard and replace it with REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA pixels. Preserve the exact jacket, its ivory fabric, dark interior lining, zipper, fine edge antialiasing, colors, lighting, shape, silhouette, camera angle, composition and size. Keep the dark interior of the jacket. Output a true RGBA transparent PNG. No checkered pattern, no gray, white or solid backdrop, no shadow outside the jacket. The checkerboard is not part of the jacket and must be entirely absent from the image data.
extractionAttempts.hats: Use case: background-extraction. Remove ONLY the baked gray/white checkerboard background from this hat. Replace every background pixel with REAL ZERO-ALPHA TRANSPARENCY. Preserve exactly the hat itself, perspective, silhouette, colors, fine texture, material, shape, details, original lighting and smooth antialiased edges. The checkerboard is contamination and must not remain anywhere. Keep the dark cloth on the underside of the hat. Output a true RGBA transparent PNG with the entire hat visible. No white or gray backdrop, no drawn transparency grid, no floor, no new shadows. Do not redraw, restyle or change the hat.
